mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Skies are clear near the Verona Area High School with a temperature of 67 degrees. We have a full moon tonight and you can catch a glimpse of the International Space Station at 3:25 AM as it travels from the west over Mount Horeb toward the northeast near the local Home Depot, reaching about halfway up the sky. The overnight low will hit 60 degrees with no rain expected.

September has been proclaimed National Senior Center Month by Mayor Diaz to recognize the vital role the center plays in our community. Additionally, the Senior Center is currently promoting their tri-shaw bike program and variety of fitness classes, including chair yoga and line dancing, to keep residents active.

There is plenty to do this week. Today, you can visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park or join trivia night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, Hop Haus Brewing hosts trivia tomorrow, and you can catch live music at Bailey's Run or Wisconsin Brewing Company this Thursday.

On August 22, officers responded to a vehicle collision in the 1200 block of Enterprise Drive where a driver was cited for multiple offences, including inattentive driving and operating after revocation.
Today's featured flavor was Chocolate Caramel Twist. As the store is now closed for the night, we look forward to tomorrow's flavor, Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, when the store opens at 10:00 AM.
